description: Na₁₀Zn₄O₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are twelve inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.86 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two ZnO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two ZnO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.59 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.66 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.59 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.77 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four ZnO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.31 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four ZnO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.36 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.66 Å. In the ninth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.68 Å. In the tenth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.47 Å. In the eleventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.57 Å. In the twelfth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four ZnO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (2.33 Å) and two longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to four O atoms to form ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two ZnO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ZnO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.04 Å. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded to four O atoms to form ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two ZnO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ZnO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.04 Å. In the third Zn site, Zn is bonded to four O atoms to form ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two ZnO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ZnO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.04 Å. In the fourth Zn site, Zn is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-1.95 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Zn atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na and two equivalent Zn atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to six Na and one Zn atom to form distorted ONa₆Zn pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₆Zn pentagonal bipyramid and  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Zn₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na and two Zn atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Zn atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Zn atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃Zn₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Zn atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Zn atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na and two Zn atoms.
